Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciate the time and the clear sense of priorities on the CortexRetail side. Quick recap and suggested next steps to keep momentum: 

- Win condition we discussed: reduce inference cost per 1k requests by 35% while keeping 99th-percentile latency under 300ms for the cart-recommendation flow.
- Current blockers: exec alignment (VP/CTO) to approve pilot budget and infra access, and a short technical deep dive for your infra/ML infra team to validate KV cache/embedding strategy.

Proposed next steps (short):
1) 30–40m Exec intro (VP/CTO + AE + Sales Eng) — goal: confirm pilot scope & approvals
2) 60m Technical deep dive (SE + infra/ML lead) — goal: runbook & success criteria

I’ve attached a one-page discovery recap and a starter mutual action plan (pilot-MAP.xlsx) to this thread. Can you confirm who from your side should join the exec intro? You mentioned Priya (CTO) — can I loop her in?

Suggested windows (PDT):
- Tue 27 Oct: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed 28 Oct: 09:30–11:00

Or if easier, pick a slot on my calendar: https://cal.com/jasmine/redwood-30m

If those work, I’ll send a calendar invite and draft agenda (5–7 bullets).

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
